title: Pro Shop Store Credit: automatic-reload posted sum and dues-standing gate
content:
## Applies to
Pro Shop Store Credit: this document covers how much an automatic reload actually posts once it is considered, for every tier that offers automatic reload.

## Basis
Once an automatic reload is considered for a tier, the tier's own standing reload sum is credited in full only while the member's separately-held club membership account currently carries no outstanding dues balance. Where that membership account's dues balance is greater than zero, the automatic reload is withheld entirely, and nothing is posted until that dues balance clears. What is posted, when it is posted, is rounded to two decimal places.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical)
Suppose a tier's own standing reload sum is 100.00 USD and the account's balance has dropped below that tier's own trigger level. If the member's club membership account currently carries no outstanding dues balance, the full 100.00 USD posts. If instead that membership account currently carries a dues balance greater than zero, nothing posts on this check, even though the balance has dropped below the trigger level.
